steps.eval: (() => { const bar = document.querySelector('[data-selection-bar="true"]'); if (!bar) throw new Error('选中 3 行后批量条未出现'); const text = bar.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' '); if (!text.includes('已选 3 项')) throw new Error('批量条计数异常: ' + text); if (bar.querySelector('[data-selection-hidden="true"]')) throw new Error('无筛选时不该出现「被筛选隐藏」提示'); return { bar: text.slice(0, 30) }; })()

(() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('[data-row-index]').length; if (rows !== 2) throw new Error('搜索 10.68 后应只剩 2 行，实际 ' + rows); const bar = document.querySelector('[data-selection-bar="true"]'); if (!bar) throw new Error('筛选后批量条消失（可见选中应为 2 台）'); const text = bar.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' '); if (!text.includes('已选 2 项')) throw new Error('批量条显示数与可见集合不同源: ' + text); const hidden = bar.querySelector('[data-selection-hidden="true"]'); if (!hidden) throw new Error('缺少「被筛选隐藏」提示'); if (!hidden.innerText.includes('1')) throw new Error('隐藏提示条数不是 1: ' + hidden.innerText); return { rows, bar: text.slice(0, 48), hidden: hidden.innerText }; })()

(() => { const bar = document.querySelector('[data-selection-bar="true"]'); const btn = bar.querySelector('[data-batch-disconnect="true"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('缺少断开按钮'); btn.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const dialog = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"], [role="alertdialog"]'); const scope = dialog || document.body; const text = (scope.innerText || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' '); if (!text.includes('断开选中的 2 台')) throw new Error('断开目标不是可见交集（期望 2 台）: ' + text.slice(0, 120)); if (text.includes('断开选中的 3 台')) throw new Error('断开目标仍包含被筛选隐藏的那台: ' + text.slice(0, 80)); const buttons = [...scope.querySelectorAll('button')]; const cancel = buttons.find((b) => (b.innerText || '').trim() === '取消'); if (cancel) cancel.click(); return { dialogs: document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"], [role="alertdialog"]').length, confirm: text.slice(0, 40) }; })()
(() => { const input = document.querySelector('input[data-search-input="true"]'); if (input) { input.focus(); } return { ok: true }; })()
